entry.title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station

entry.title: Turkish police detain dozens in raids on gay bars and homes of LGBTQ+ activists
entry.summary: Human rights groups in Turkey have accused the government of using a family- values campaign to target the LGBTQ+ community.

entry.title: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call

entry.title: Trump says he will remove all Irish whiskey tariffs as he ends two-day visit
entry.summary: Whiskey distilled in the Republic of Ireland faces the standard 15% tariff which applies to EU goods entering the US.

entry.title: French officials investigate if malicious act caused train derailment

entry.title: Bulgaria investigates fire at weapons site that owner calls sabotage
